$comment: Patterns of the name check (scripts/verify/names.ts; TASK-0003 completion condition 1, 04-aihot-adoption.md 4.3 and 4.6 item 1). This file is exception 6, the check's own patterns: no other script or test spells them out.
$comment_exceptions: Paths (lanes.yaml syntax) where the names and marks may appear. A file listed with sameAs is covered only while it is byte-identical to that handoff template; one listed with upstream only while its SHA-256 is that upstream file's in the source manifest. tasks/INDEX.md is generated from the cards (node scripts/verify/tasks.ts --write-index).
$comment_notExceptions: Never covered, whatever exception matches: the upstream promotional images and the upstream's own documentation, deleted by T-0002 and not part of the handoff package (TASK-0003 :126 item 2).
$comment_references: Paths and file names of the registration and handoff files (regular expressions, case-sensitive): not hits in the repository, wherever they appear. The build output and the site's outputs get no such allowance.
$comment_manifest: The upstream source manifest: SHA-256 of every file of the imported upstream commit.
$comment_brand: Upstream brand assets: no file may have the SHA-256 of a manifest entry under these prefixes (no exceptions; 4.3 (a)).
